items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: That was a famous... department store. They sold everything.

ctx.x: So I was born in Seven. And maybe I left Greenville when I was about... Maybe a year old. Because we were out... We were living on South Scott Street in 1911. So I was born in Seven. And maybe I left Greenville when I was about... Yeah, maybe one year or a year and a half old. Because we lived down on Frenchman Street. Was born down on Frenchman Street. And my sister, who was two years younger than I was... Was born down on Frenchman Street. On Frenchman of Decatur. On the third floor. on the third floor, the…

Rougelot. Rougelot. R-O-U-G-E-L-O-T. That was a famous... That was a famous... department store. They sold everything. It was like D.H. Holmes or Maison Blanche, or similar to that. It was the biggest store down there. The thing about Frenchman Street, getting into that, there was a street that had everything on it.
